title: List store and list tools
goal: Lists and items persist in SQLite and are reachable as gated tools
acceptance: lists.add_items, lists.show, lists.set_done and lists.remove_item exist as tools with gate classes (Green for the owner's own lists)
Several items in one request become separate items; a duplicate is reported, not added twice
Survives restart; unit tests with invented items
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
